final: WITH team_averages AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(w) AS avg_wins, AVG(1.0 * (g - l) / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM team_averages) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_wins, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_wins - o.avg_wins FROM team_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_wins IS NOT NULL AND t.avg_wins > o.avg_wins ORDER BY t.avg_wins - o.avg_wins DESC LIMIT 10
